subject: general
question: From March 9 to 12, 2025, the second part of India's fifth Khelo India Winter Games was conducted in which of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulmarg**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **second part** of the **5th edition** of the **Khelo India Winter Games (KIWG)** was scheduled to be held in **Gulmarg**, situated in the **Baramulla district** of **Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• This second leg of the prestigious national event took place from **March 9 to 12, 2025**, featuring high-adrenaline snow sports.
 
• While the **Gulmarg** phase focused on mountain-based activities, the **first part** of the **2025** games was hosted in **Leh**, **Ladakh**, between **January 30 and February 2, 2025**.
 
• The events conducted during the **Gulmarg** leg primarily included **Alpine Skiing**, **Snowboarding**, **Ski Mountaineering**, and **Nordic Skiing**.
 
• The games are a collaborative effort between the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, the **Sports Authority of India (SAI)**, and the **J&K Sports Council** to promote winter sports culture in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gulmarg as a Sports Hub**: 
 
 
• Known as the "Meadow of Flowers," **Gulmarg** is one of the world's premier **ski destinations** located at an altitude of approximately **2,650 meters** in the **Pir Panjal Range** of the **Himalayas**.
 
• It has hosted the majority of the **Khelo India Winter Games** editions since their inception due to its world-class slopes at **Kongdoori** and **Mary Shoulder**.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India Winter Games (KIWG) History**: 
 
 
• The **first edition** of the **KIWG** was held in **2020**. It was launched to identify and nurture talent for international winter sports competitions like the **Winter Olympics**.
 
• The **4th edition** in **2024** also followed a dual-venue format between **Ladakh** and **Jammu & Kashmir**, where **Army Sports Control Board (ASCB)** topped the medal tally.
 
 
 
• **Broad Objective of Khelo India**: 
 
 
• The **Khelo India program** was introduced in **2018** by the **Government of India** to revive the sports culture at the grass-root level by building a strong framework for all sports played in the country.
 
• It encompasses various verticals including **Khelo India Youth Games**, **University Games**, and **Winter Games**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sports Disciplines**: The **5th KIWG** included diverse disciplines. While **Leh** hosted **Ice Hockey** and **Speed Skating**, the **Gulmarg** leg was dedicated to snow-dependent sports.
 
• **Mascot and Symbolism**: The mascot for the games typically features the **Snow Leopard** (often named **'Sheen-e-She'** in local dialect), which symbolizes the **Himalayan heritage** and the spirit of resilience.
 
• **National Participation**: Hundreds of athletes from various **States**, **Union Territories**, and **Central Boards** participate, fostering national integration through sports.
 
• **Tourism Impact**: Hosting these games in **2025** significantly boosts **winter tourism** in **Jammu & Kashmir** and **Ladakh**, positioning India as a global winter sports destination.
